summary:

title: Scammers Drain $56,000 From Massachusetts Woman After Masquerading as Bank Employees
summary:
A Massachusetts woman lost $56,000 after scammers allegedly posed as employees of her bank and convinced her to transfer her savings into a supposed “safe account.” The 43-year-old Hingham resident told police that the scheme began around 6 p.m. when she received an unexpected call from someone claiming to work in her bank’s fraud department, […]
The post Scammers Drain $56,000 From Massachusetts Woman After Masquerading as Bank Employees appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: A Massachusetts woman lost $56,000 after scammers posing as bank employees convinced her to transfer her savings into a fraudulent "safe account." The victim received an unexpected call from someone claiming to represent her bank's fraud department, leading to the significant financial loss. Authorities are currently investigating the incident.
